preconditions.description: N and M are integers within the specified bounds, with M not exceeding N.

preconditions.expression: len(map1_lines) == N and all(len(row) == M for row in map1_lines)
preconditions.description: The first map consists of exactly N lines, each containing exactly M lowercase Latin characters.

preconditions.expression: len(map2_lines) == M and all(len(row) == N for row in map2_lines)
preconditions.description: The second map consists of exactly M lines, each containing exactly N lowercase Latin characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in row) for row in map1_lines + map2_lines)
preconditions.description: All characters in both maps are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output indices i and j are valid 1-based row and column start positions within the respective maps.

postconditions.expression: all(map1_lines[i - 1 + r][c] == map2_lines[r][j - 1 + c] for r in range(M) for c in range(M))
postconditions.description: The M x M subgrid of the first map starting at row i matches the M x M subgrid of the second map starting at column j, where the second map's subgrid is formed by taking rows 0 to M-1 and columns j-1 to j+M-2.
